Advertisement View all journals Saved research Search Account Log in Content Explore content About the journal Publish with us Subscribe Sign up for alerts RSS feed nature nature water perspectives article Perspective Published: 02 October 2026 Calibrating antimicrobial resistance influent and effluent signals in wastewater systems Αndrea Naziri ORCID: orcid.org/0000-0002-6090-308X 1 , 2 , Stelios Chatzimichail 1 , Popi Karaolia ORCID: orcid.org/0000-0003-0867-8177 1 & … Despo Fatta-Kassinos ORCID: orcid.org/0000-0003-1173-0941 1 , 2 Show authors Nature Water ( 2026 ) Cite this article Save article View saved research Abstract Here, in this Perspective, we discuss how the detailed measurements of microbial hazards generated by wastewater surveillance remain fundamentally underdetermined: they quantify variation without resolving the biological states they represent. This limitation is particularly evident for antimicrobial resistance, where large-scale monitoring is advancing in the absence of parameters that link wastewater concentrations to population-level burden and environmental risk.
